$comment: The visual check of provider photographs. It can only REJECT: a photograph is eligible only when its photographer's caption already identifies the species (src/lib/species-media/provider/verify.ts). ACCEPT records the factual alt text written after looking at the photograph, claiming nothing (sex, age, place, behaviour) that is not visible. Keyed `<provider>:<photo id>`.
